response.title: can my home run on solar generator
response.answer:
Yes, you can run your entire home on a solar generator, including appliances, air conditioning, refrigerators, lighting, and electronics. However, you need a sufficiently large solar and battery system.

The key question is whether you want to power your home during outages or live completely off-grid.

Three ways to power your home with solar
Shop

1. Portable solar generator

Approx. $1,000–$5,000+

Powers essentials such as refrigerators, Wi-Fi, lights, and some small appliances. Usually not enough for an entire home.

Shop

2. Whole-home solar battery backup

Approx. $15,000–$40,000+ installed

Can power much or all of a home during outages, depending on battery capacity and appliance loads. Solar panels can recharge the batteries.

Shop

3. Fully off-grid solar system

Approx. $30,000–$100,000+ installed

Designed to power your home without the utility grid, with enough solar panels and batteries for nights and cloudy days. Backup generation may still be useful.

How much power would you need?

For illustration, a house using 30 kWh of electricity daily might need:

Component

	

Example size




Solar panels

	

8–12 kW




Battery storage

	

30–60 kWh




Inverter

	

8–15 kW




Battery-only runtime

	

Roughly 1–2 days at average usage, before losses

Actual requirements depend heavily on air conditioning, electric heating, EV charging, weather, and location.

A whole-home system also needs a properly installed transfer switch or approved interconnection equipment. You cannot safely power household circuits by plugging a generator into a regular outlet.

Let me size a system for your house
House size (square feet)
Average monthly electricity bill ($)
What is your goal?
Power my whole house during outages
Run my house completely off-grid
Reduce my electricity bill
Estimate my solar system

With those details, I can estimate how many solar panels and batteries you would need, whether a solar generator is practical, and roughly how much the system would cost.
